title: Jumu‘ah prayer – the weekly worship
intro: The Friday prayer at Dhuhr time: 16 rak‘ahs, two adhans and the khutbah.

learn.html: Jumu‘ah is the weekly prayer, prayed on Friday at the time of Dhuhr. Every adult Muslim man of sound mind must pray it. Muslim women may pray Jumu‘ah, but it is not a duty for them.
For Jumu‘ah to be prayed, at least four people are needed: the imam and three men who pray behind him (muqtadis).

learn.title: 16 rak‘ahs
learn.html: Jumu‘ah has sixteen rak‘ahs: 4 sunnah, 2 fard, 4 sunnah, 4 akhir adh-dhuhr (the last Dhuhr) and 2 sunnat al-waqt (the sunnah of the time).

items: The first adhan is called – it invites the people of the jama‘ah to come to Jumu‘ah.
After the adhan we pray 4 rak‘ahs of sunnah, the same way as the sunnah of Dhuhr.

learn.label: Niyyah for the sunnah of Jumu‘ah
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-jumu‘ati, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of Jumu‘ah, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: The second adhan is called, and after it the imam gives the khutbah.
After the khutbah we pray the 2 rak‘ahs of fard, which must be prayed in jama‘ah behind the imam.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The khutbah is the imam’s talk – a short lecture the imam gives to those present. The people of the jama‘ah must listen to the imam’s khutbah.

learn.label: Niyyah for the fard of Jumu‘ah
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ فَرْضِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهَذَا الْإِمَامِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata fardil-jumu‘ati, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati, iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the fard of Jumu‘ah, on time, facing the Qiblah, following this imam. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.html: After the fard of Jumu‘ah we pray ten rak‘ahs: 4 sunnah, 4 akhir adh-dhuhr and 2 sunnat al-waqt.

learn.label: 4 rak‘ahs of sunnah – prayed like the sunnah of Dhuhr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-jumu‘ati, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of Jumu‘ah, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.label: 4 rak‘ahs of akhir adh-dhuhr – prayed like the fard of Dhuhr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ آخِرِ الظُّهْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata aakhiridh-dhuhri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the last Dhuhr, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.label: 2 rak‘ahs of sunnat al-waqt – prayed like the sunnah of Fajr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْوَقْتِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-waqti, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of the time, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.html: Practise: Build the Salah – the Dhuhr and Fajr levels help you with the sunnahs of Jumu‘ah.

practice.title: Jumu‘ah in order
practice.prompt: Put the parts of Jumu‘ah in order.

options: On Friday, at the time of Dhuhr
Every adult Muslim man of sound mind
Nobody – it is optional for everyone

questions.q: How many people are needed at least for Jumu‘ah?
options: Four – the imam and three men

questions.q: How many rak‘ahs does Jumu‘ah have?

options: The imam’s talk, which everyone must listen to

questions.q: What do we add to the niyyah of the fard of Jumu‘ah?

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 What is Jumu‘ah? Who must pray it? How many people are needed at least? How many rak‘ahs does it have, and how are they divided?
🖼️ Choose a task: make a poster comparing Dhuhr and Jumu‘ah, with pictures and drawings in boxes.

📖 Choose a task: find the ayah that speaks about the duty of Jumu‘ah (look in Surah Al-Jumu‘ah) and write it on a sheet of paper. With your muallim, put it on your masjid’s notice board – each week a different student can do it.
🧠 Choose a task: make a word web – what does the word “Jumu‘ah” make you think of?
